content:
We need DBE for C14H12O6. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring O, S, halogens). No N. So DBE = 14 - 12/2 + 1 = 14 - 6 + 1 = 9. So integer 9.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to follow process, maybe call retrieve_dbe_formula to get formula. Not necessary but okay. Use tool.
